name: io.github.ashishodu2023/tidevec
title: TideVec Memory
description: Long-term agent memory that knows when facts change: newer memories supersede older ones.

packageArguments.name: --embedder
packageArguments.description: Embedding backend: auto, hashing, openai or sentence-transformers

environmentVariables.name: TIDEVEC_URL
environmentVariables.description: host:port of a tidevec-server. Leave unset to use an embedded database.

environmentVariables.name: TIDEVEC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for the tidevec-server (server mode only).

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Enables OpenAI embeddings when sentence-transformers is not installed.
